name: Kenku
summary: Flightless bird-folk cursed to lose their wings and their own voices. Kenku speak by mimicking sounds they have heard, and they are expert copyists and sneaks.

age.summary: Kenku have short lives, reaching maturity at 12 and living about 60 years.

alignment.summary: Kenku are chaotic and rarely good.

size.description: Kenku are around 5 feet tall and light-boned.

speed.description: Your base walking speed is 30 feet.

languages.description: You can speak, read, and write Common and Auran.

features.name: Expert Forgery
features.summary: You can copy writing and craftwork you have seen. You have advantage on checks to produce forgeries or duplicates of existing objects.

features.name: Kenku Training
features.summary: You are proficient in two of these skills: Acrobatics, Deception, Stealth and Sleight of Hand.

features.name: Mimicry
features.summary: You can mimic sounds and voices you have heard. A listener needs a successful Insight check against your Deception to tell it is fake.
